messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — Elevated 5xx + timeouts in production across gateway (region: us-west-2). Paging oncall. https://telemetry/redwood/incidents/6432109999 :rotating_light:
Paula (eng): @Ben are you seeing the pager? I got a deploy notice ~2m ago but not sure which service yet :thinking_face:
Ben (oncall): yep got it. I'm looking at traces and gateway logs now. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~3.2s, p99 ~6.8s, 5xx rate from 0.05% -> 6.2%. Starting triage. :eyes:
Samir (sre): thx. tagging in Maya for infra-side connection checks — could be connection pool exhaustion or kv-cache misses. @Maya can you confirm node health and connection saturation?
Maya (infra): looking... cpu/mem on frontends nominal. tcp connections per host trending up. envoy upstream_rq_5xx increased. Checking k8s events and pod restarts.
deploy-bot: Deploy event: service=gateway, image=gateway:2026-03-15-09f2a, user=Paula, sha=8f3b2a. Started 2026-03-15T09:02:13Z.
Paula (eng): that was my canary -> global rollout. I rolled a config tweak to connection pooling defaults (increase max_inflight) in that release. Hm.
Ben (oncall): timeline looks like metric inflection +90s after deploy. Could be the new pooling change causing cascading queueing. Capturing logs:
```
[09:03:45] upstream request timeout id=xyz status=504 route=generate
[09:03:50] downstream reset id=abc err=too_many_inflight
[09:04:10] kvcache miss spike: miss_rate=0.78 -> 0.95
```
Samir (sre): kvcache miss spike could be related but not sure it's root. If the new pooling increases concurrency, we might be hitting backend timeouts more. Suggest rollback of release-2026-03-15-09f2a to confirm.
Paula (eng): agree. preparing rollback. Will execute a rollback to previous stable image.
Paula (eng): Running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/gateway --to-revision=12`
infra-bot: rollout undo started for deployment/gateway -> targetRevision=12. 6 pods terminating, 6 new pods coming up. Draining 2 pods at a time per AZ.
Ben (oncall): I'm throttling non-essential customer traffic via route-weight to reduce load on gateway while rollback in progress. command: `routeshift set gateway weight=40% --until=6432110200`
Maya (infra): I see new pods come up on node pool. health checks passing. backend latency per pod down from ~4s to ~900ms on the earliest rolled-back pods.
Paula (eng): rollback finished on control plane. Confirming rollout status... all pods updated to revision 12.
Paula (eng): quick check: p95 dropped to 220ms, p99 ~1.1s, 5xx down to 0.2% within ~70s post-rollback.
Ben (oncall): Observed user error surface reduced. Sending initial incident triage: high-confidence rollback mitigated regression. Notifying customer-impact channel.
Samir (sre): Good. Putting incident in stabilization mode. I'll take ownership for follow-up and postmortem. Assigning Sev timeline and action items:
- Capture binary config diff between rev12 and rev13 (Paula)
- Re-run load tests with pooling change in staging and chaos conditions (Samir + Maya)
- Evals on KV cache behavior under higher concurrency (Eng-ML + Infra)
- Customer impact summary + comms draft (Paula)

Paula (eng): diff: changed gateway.config.pool.max_inflight from 250 -> 800, and adjusted idle_timeout from 30s -> 10s. I pushed to make more parallelism for a particular workload; didn't anticipate backend saturation.
Maya (infra): from infra view, many backend instances hit queued requests and started timing out, which cascaded to gateway 504s. Also saw brief spike in connection resets.
Ben (oncall): tagging in @escalation-bot for any customers with active SLAs. Customer-impact: A subset of traffic (routes to model-gen) experienced elevated 5xx and timeouts for ~5m window. No data loss. We'll prepare an incident banner if comms team wants.
deploy-bot: note: automated canary rollback not configured for this service (manual rollback executed).
Samir (sre): handoff: Ben — keep monitoring for 30m and escalate if any reappearance. Paula — please file a postmortem draft and include config rationale + playbook change to require staging perf run for pooling changes. I'll own follow-up verification tests and the timeline.
Paula (eng): will file doc and include diffs and perf graphs.
Ben (oncall): monitoring in watch mode. I'll post final lift when we pass 30m no-regression window. :white_check_mark:
Paula (eng): thanks everyone. small note: we should add a preflight gate to run an increasing-concurrency KV load to catch these miss cascades earlier.
Samir (sre): agreed. Also adding an automated canary rollback policy to the service.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated via rollback. Incident status: stabilizing -> monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m or on new developments.
Ben (oncall): final note before handoff: capturing traces for postmortem in `s3://redwood-incidents/6432109999/traces/` :thumbsup:
Maya (infra): leaving a short runbook annotation on infra issues observed. ping me for follow-up infra tuning.
Samir (sre): handing off to follow-up owner. End of live incident channel.
summary: Mitigated a deploy-induced timeout/5xx regression by rolling back gateway config change that increased max_inflight from 250 to 800. p95/p99 and 5xx returned near baseline after rollback; follow-up postmortem and staging gating planned.
